content: KMC v3.2.4 (released 2024-02-09) official GitHub release ships KMC3.2.4.mac.arm64.tar.gz prebuilt Apple Silicon binaries (verified via GitHub releases API) - simplest path for BENCH-V2-01. bioconda kmc 3.2.4 has osx-arm64 build 2 uploaded 2024-10-09 (verified via anaconda.org API). No Homebrew formula exists (verified locally: brew search kmc returns only kmod/jmc). Source build: make -f makefile_mac, bundled x86-64 zlib must be replaced on arm64, and ulimit -n 2048 is required before running KMC. jellyfish 2.3.1 already installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/jellyfish.
